note: Debt this project has ACCEPTED, and when it must next be looked at. Every entry is a holding that a gate already prevents from GROWING — growth is handled elsewhere. What nothing handled before this file existed is AGE: a baseline that can only go down will sit at the same number for ever if nobody is forced to return to it. `node scripts/validate-debt-expiry.cjs` fails an entry whose `reviewedOn` is older than its `toleranceDays`, and `--review` refuses without a written reason. Register row 305.

entries.holdsWhat: page-local chrome (thick coloured left bars) not yet migrated to the shared arrangement
entries.why: A mechanical migration with no behaviour change. It is large but unarguable, so it can be done in batches — which is exactly the kind of work that never gets scheduled without a clock.

entries.holdsWhat: 8-line normalised blocks shared by 2+ files, allowlisted so no NEW pair can appear
entries.why: Some of it is legitimate (directive implementations share a shape). The danger is that the allowance has no expiry, so a pair banked as 'unavoidable' in September is still banked in March and nobody re-reads it.

entries.holdsWhat: hardcoded colour literals in stylesheets, frozen per file
entries.why: The inline-style twin of this (colour-literals) went 263 -> 37 in one session, so the same method works here. Three files already report LOWER and are waiting to be banked.

entries.holdsWhat: INV-NO-UNMEASURED-CALENDAR-CLAIM violations held by a whitelist entry rather than fixed
entries.why: This is the gate that ADVERTISED itself as blocking and does not: its header calls these violations held, and the run exits 0. Five directive classes still emit a non-zero score off the calendar. Shorter tolerance than the cosmetic debt above because it is a scoring path.
